reference: Hand-written Interlude item templates. Ids, names, slots, weapon types, armor types, icons, crystal grades, crystal counts, enchant scrolls, equip conditions, magic flag, stackability, and pDef were checked against L2J Mobius CT 0 Interlude. This file is not Mobius data. equip fields are the player conditions from that item's cond block. scroll fields are the enchant scroll target, fail mode, grade, max enchant, and bonus rate. Shop rows add Mobius reference price and weight for Talking Island merchants. sellable false matches a zero price, adena, or is_sellable false.
